note: Locale registry (Phase 5). Only 'live' locales are routed, linked, put in hreflang or the sitemap. 'planned' locales exist so the architecture is ready; none has reviewed content. A locale becomes live only after a qualified human reviewer approves every page in it (see docs/phase5/INTERNATIONALIZATION_PLAN.md). Machine translation output is a draft input for a reviewer, never publishable on its own.
url_strategy: path-prefix: English stays at /…; other locales at /{code}/… (for example /de/tool.php?id=chatgpt). Same domain, so authority is shared and no per-country domains or cookies are needed.
